reasoning: Shows a standard three-item bulleted list. While recognizable at a glance for tasks centered on outlines, agendas, inventories, or bullet points, it is rather generic inside a to-do app and many specific lists (grocery list, guest list, packing list) are better served by icons for their concrete subjects.
